description: Buy a 24h Oracle Watch window for one asset and return the one-time control token. Use it when an agent will poll throughout a window instead of paying per snapshot. Do not use it repeatedly for the same window and never share the token. Returns windowId, the oww_ token, the covered expiry and the credits charged. Deprecated alias: prefer oracle_watch_window with op "begin". Removed on 2027-01-06.

chain.description: Chain-name filter (e.g. "ethereum", "base", "hyperevm"); not a numeric chain id

symbol.description: Asset to monitor for the window

name: oracle_watch_window_begin
